about: Decisions the data must not override (Util/item-builds/generate.js reads this). Each pin: hero, pos (omit = every position), a reason, and any of: require (items the list must buy), forbid (items it must not), before ([a, b]: a is bought before b), adjacent ([a, b]: b right after a), boots (the pair to buy), start (the starting entries), next (entries right after the start), keep (true: the old list stays as it is). Tests/test_item_builds.lua holds the same decisions.
